AC-S4-06.2.detail: An imprecise or conflicting trigger date, an unconfirmed exclusion, a missing calendar year and a rule that changes inside the trigger range each give a RANGE with its reason; never a single date.

AC-S4-06.3.detail: No deadline without a rule, an authority and a trigger locator; every record carries VERIFY and G9; every rule row cites the exact line it comes from.

AC-S4-06.arithmetic.detail: Property tests: day counting against an independent walk (1996-2032), month-end and leap-day clamping, monotonic month arithmetic, roll-forward never on a closed day, calendar-file format.

AC-S4-06.1.reason: 100% match with legal-editor answers needs real signed rule rows and court calendars (Q-S4-02, Q-S4-11). The shipped limitation rules (caseforge.india.limitation-rules) are DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; no court calendar is installed, so shipped rules give a range, not a single date.
